mapper.select: SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corpGr , t1.ENC_ACCT_NO AS encAcctNo , t1.FUND_CD AS fundCd , t1.FUND_NM AS fundNm , t1.TYPE_GB AS typeGb , TO_CHAR(t1.FST_SEOLJ_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS fstSeoljYmd , t1.SINTAK_GIGAN AS sintakGigan , TO_CHAR(t1.BF_GYUL_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS bfGyulYmd , TO_CHAR(t1.AF_GYUL_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS afGyulYmd , t1.PRE_BASIC AS preBasic , t1.BASIC_PER AS basicPer , t1.BM_PER AS bmPer , t1.SUCCESS_PER AS successPer , t1.SERIES_GB AS seriesGb , t1.TARGET_JASAN AS targetJasan , t1.GYUL_GI AS gyulGi , t1.HAEJI_GB AS haejiGb , TO_CHAR(t1.HAEJI_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS haejiYmd , t1.RE_SEOLJ_YEAR AS reSeoljYear , t1.RE_SEOLJ_AEK AS reSeoljAek , t1.MG_CD AS mgCd , t1.SUSU_RT AS susuRt , t1.EMAIL1 AS email1 , TO_CHAR(t1.RE_SEOLJ_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reSeoljYmd , t1.UNYONG_SABUN AS unyongSabun , t1.ORDER_SEND AS orderSend , t1.EXPENSE_YN AS expenseYn , t1.ALIAS_CODE AS aliasCode , t1.SPECIAL_NOTE AS specialNote , CASE WHEN NVL(t1.SPECIAL_NOTE, ' ') = ' ' THEN ' ' ELSE 'NOTE' END AS noteText , TO_DECRYPTS (ENC_ACCT_NO) AS acctNo , 1 AS pVisible FROM SZM0IA t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} ORDER BY t1.HAEJI_GB ASC, t1.MG_CD ASC, t1.FUND_NM ASC, t1.RE_SEOLJ_YMD ASC

SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corpGr , t1.FUND_CD AS fundCd , t1.GYUL_GI AS gyulGi , TO_CHAR(t1.BF_GYUL_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS bfGyulYmd , TO_CHAR(t1.AF_GYUL_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS afGyulYmd , t1.ILSU AS ilsu , t1.GI_SONIK_AEK AS giSonikAek , t1.WM_SEOLJ_AEK AS wmSeoljAek , TO_CHAR(t1.WM_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS wmDt , TO_CHAR(t1.HAEJI_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS haejiYmd , t1.DIST_CALC AS distCalc , TO_CHAR(t1.INCHUL_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS inchulYmd , t1.IN_AEK AS inAek , t1.AF_GIJUN AS afGijun , 1 AS pVisible FROM SZM0GI t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} ORDER BY t1.BF_GYUL_YMD DESC

SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corpGr , t1.FUND_CD AS fundCd , TO_CHAR(t1.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS trYmd , t1.WONBON_AEK AS wonbonAek , t1.IN_AEK AS inAek , t1.OUT_AEK AS outAek , t1.GIGAN_ILSU AS giganIlsu , t1.PASS_ILSU AS passIlsu , t1.IO_JO AS ioJo , t1.MOD_DT AS modDt , t1.MOD_USER AS modUser , CASE WHEN NVL(t1.MOD_USER, 'start') = 'start' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS modYn , 1 AS pVisible FROM SZT0IO t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} ORDER BY t1.TR_YMD DESC
